reports.title: Revenue by product category
reports.description: Total line-level revenue grouped by product Category (Superstore).
reports.sql: SELECT p.Category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.Sales), 2) AS revenue FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Products p ON oi.Product_Key = p.Product_Key GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY revenue DESC

reports.title: Order count by region
reports.description: Number of distinct orders per geographic Region.
reports.sql: SELECT l.Region AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.Order_ID) AS order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Locations l ON o.Location_ID = l.Location_ID GROUP BY l.Region ORDER BY order_count DESC

reports.title: Top 20 customers by revenue
reports.description: Customers ranked by total Order_Items sales.
reports.sql: SELECT c.Customer_Name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(oi.Sales), 2) AS revenue FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.Order_ID = o.Order_ID JOIN Customers c ON o.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID GROUP BY c.Customer_ID ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20
